key_decisions: The curated pip pass STAYS inside POST /comfy/start with the engine down - that placement is MPI-459/457 and is the only point that survives an upgrade wiping site-packages. Only the reporting changed.
The frontend cannot observe the phase mid-request (it awaits the whole start POST), so it asks GET /comfy/deps-pending BEFORE starting rather than streaming progress.

The install label is dropped as soon as /comfy/start answers, not when the engine is ready: measured 2.5s of pip against 44s of ComfyUI boot, so holding the label for the whole wait mislabelled most of it.
constraints: HARD: never delete anything under G:\CubricModels. It is the shared weights store, not part of the engine. The engine root is c:\AI\Mpi\Cubric-Vision\engine\ (dev checkout) and engine/mpi_models lives inside it - check what the wipe would take before running it.
A recursive delete that fails has ALREADY destroyed part of the tree (node deletes children concurrently), so enumerate survivors before diagnosing anything after a failed wipe.

A concurrent session shares this repo's playwright-cli browser and its `goto` will swap your page out from under you, silently wiping window globals set by an earlier eval. Confirm location.href before trusting a sample. Also never drive :3000 or any instance you did not launch - use npm run app:isolated, which prints READY <url> on its own free port and profile.
Do NOT pipe `npm run app:isolated` through `tail` - tail buffers until exit, so the READY line never appears and it reads as a dead app. Redirect to a file instead.

The deps marker is engine/ComfyUI_windows_portable/python_embeded/.cubric_python_deps and its current correct hash is 48d7ca7ee6226c88. Staling it forces the pip pass without a wipe (that is how this session verified the label); a wipe removes it along with site-packages.

The blocking modal only shows on a NON-background start (a manual generation path). shell.js boot auto-start passes { background: true } and shows nothing - so trigger via ComfyUIController.ensureServerRunning({}) or a real generation, not by relaunching the app.
